name: Jatoga Online
summary: Brisbane dialup ISP with subscriber subdomains + web directory (run by Jarrod Friedland, ~1998); wound down, domain became personal blog.

events.details: Dialup ISP + web directory. Owned and operated by Jarrod Friedland t/a JATOGA Online (his own words). NB: his ZENWEB-listed ABN 97 641 180 034 never carried the JATOGA name — not stamped.

refs.label: Own 2001 company-profile page states the sole-trader structure and ties the site to his ZENWEB trading names.
His sole-trader ABN (cancelled 31 Mar 2026); ABR lists ZENWEB names but not JATOGA, consistent with the same person's unregistered trading name.
